title: ATC only from the site's own copy; the FHIR store restarted after a terminology change (lane V, 2026-11-23)

findings.claim: A box that loaded the vocabulary from the shipped atc.parquet keeps those ATC concepts, with WHOCC's English names, in omop.concept after this card: a vocabulary load upserts and never removes a concept; only the term:atc attribute rows are emptied on the next load

Without the site's own ATC copy, every shipped medication ValueSet names its ATC codes by the code itself (M04AA01), not by a drug name: the reviewer of a rule set sees codes only until the site loads its index

Each terminology change now restarts the FHIR store (38 s on the test machine, up to 15 minutes allowed): a CQL evaluation or a validation asked during it fails; install, the manual update and a bundle update are the only callers, but a screening run at that moment is not held back

RA-JAK-EXC-01 (any prior biologic DMARD or JAK inhibitor) and RA-COH-INC-06 (a biologic within a year) read biologics from TrialBox's groupers 'ra biologic' and 'biologic dmard or jak inhibitor': the TNF inhibitors (L04AB), tocilizumab (L04AC07) and, for RA-JAK, the JAK inhibitors (L04AF). Abatacept, sarilumab, rituximab and the other interleukin inhibitors are in none of them, so a patient on one is not excluded (RA-JAK) or not counted (RA-COH), silently, without even an unknown; found while checking the OCR pass's tocilizumab item (pre-existing on master, not changed by V-18b)
